reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch attribute the two names to levirate marriage, with Pedaiah as Zerubbabel's biological father and Shealtiel as his legal father by inheritance.

discrepancy.note: Strauss catalogs it among Matthew's genealogical discrepancies: Chronicles derives Zerubbabel from Jechoniah through Pedaiah, but Ezra and Haggai name Shealtiel as his father.

quotes.text: he is descended from Jechoniah, not through Shealtiel, but through his brother Pedaiah. In Ezra v. 2 , and Haggai i. 1 , however, Zerubbabel is designated, as here, the son of Shealtiel.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, trans. George Eliot (1846), ch. on the genealogies, on 1 Chronicles 3:19 and Ezra 3:2.

sides.snippet: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei
sides.verseText: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

sides.snippet: Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brothers
sides.verseText: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brothers the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brothers, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
